PHASE.NAME: Test Environment Soundness
PHASE.GOAL: Resolve FIX/C1 by removing unsafe process environment mutation from tests while preserving isolated tracking and filter behavior.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Test-specific data directories, project roots, trust stores, and session ids are passed through explicit test seams instead of runtime process environment mutation.
Tracking, filter trust, indexer, dashboard, skill, and cascade tests exercise project-local behavior without changing process-wide cwd or environment in the unit-test process.

STEPS.step-1: Replaced tracking test env/cwd mutation with Tracker::new_for_test explicit db path, project key, and session id overrides.
STEPS.step-2: Replaced project filter and filter trust env/cwd mutation with explicit filter path and trust-store test helpers.
STEPS.step-3: Added explicit-root search helpers so graph-aware search tests no longer mutate cwd.
STEPS.step-4: Added explicit-root search explanation helper for dashboard tests.
STEPS.step-5: Added explicit-root SkillEngine construction for run-history tests.
STEPS.step-6: Added explicit-root cascade MCP test handlers to avoid cwd mutation.
STEPS.step-7: Audited integration tests; remaining cwd mutation is isolated to a separate integration-test process and does not mutate env.

RISKS.RISK: std::env mutation is process-global; test isolation must serialize all remaining mutations until production APIs accept explicit paths.
